reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents an instructional guide to a named trading tournament, including eligibility, participation requirements, and leaderboard rewards rather than a fixed investment return. The token rewards are tied to verified-user status, trading volume, and competitive ranking, while voluntary affiliate links are openly disclosed.

citations.quote: The user who may not meet this threshold, will not qualify for any reward under this trading volume tournament.
These two pairs also need to be traded in both pairs due to the trading volume requirement.
Don’t miss this chance to earn FREE crypto rewards just by trading!

opening.argument: The video links a substantial token reward directly to actions that require participation and trading. It advertises “Win 3.5M TREE Tokens,” then specifies a “Minimum trading requirements (500 USD)” and explains that users who do not meet the threshold receive no reward. The instructions therefore function as a solicitation: register, trade qualifying pairs, and pursue the advertised tokens. Calling the reward conditional does not remove the core promise-action relationship; it defines the action required to access the promise. The presentation also tells viewers to trade TREE against USDT and USDC, making this an actionable crypto acquisition pitch rather than a merely informational discussion.

citations.quote: The user who may not meet this threshold, will not qualify for any reward under this trading volume tournament.
These two pairs also need to be traded in both pairs due to the trading volume requirement.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference argument treats eligibility conditions as evidence of legitimacy, but those conditions actually make the solicitation explicit: viewers must trade a stated volume to pursue the advertised tokens. Calling the activity a tournament does not change that the video connects a crypto reward to a required financial action. The cited “FREE” wording also makes the offer sound effortless while the instructions require qualifying trades.

citations.quote: Don’t miss this chance to earn FREE crypto rewards just by trading!
The user who may not meet this threshold, will not qualify for any reward under this trading volume tournament.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The reward is not presented as guaranteed or unconditional. The material describes a competitive program in which eligibility depends on verified status and trading volume, and the amount depends on rank. The opening’s quotes show a participation requirement, but they do not show that viewers are promised a return merely for depositing money or buying a token.

citations.quote: The user who may not meet this threshold, will not qualify for any reward under this trading volume tournament.

opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together: a headline promising 3.5 million TREE tokens, a short promotion window, a countdown-style trading page, and repeated instructions to act through trading and registration. The page visibly pairs the token-voucher claim with a “Trade Now” button, while the description directs viewers to Telegram and multiple exchange links. The description also advertises “40% to 60% commission” for an external exchange signup. Taken together, the unusually large crypto reward, time pressure, action button, and referral pathway create a strong solicitation pattern, even though the text adds disclaimers. A disclaimer does not negate the practical pressure to act quickly and transact.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference side calls this an ordinary promotion, but that framing understates the combination of urgency, crypto rewards, and transaction prompts. A countdown and “Trade Now” button accompany the token claim, while the description supplies outside contact and exchange pathways. Ranking language explains the mechanics; it does not remove the pressure created by the large headline reward and limited period.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These signals do not establish deception. The countdown corresponds to a stated promotion period, and the page identifies the activity as a trading tournament with eligibility and ranking rules. The referral disclosure expressly says commissions may be received, which makes that relationship visible rather than hidden. Nothing cited shows that the prize was fabricated or that the exchange links were fraudulent.

citations.quote: if you click on the link and make a purchase or sign up, we may receive a commission or referral fee

opening.argument: Although presented as a guide, the content operates as promotional steering. It tells viewers how to find the event, click the participation control, select TREE pairs, and complete buy-and-sell steps. The visual page places a “Join Now” control beside the reward description, and the video ends by directing viewers to complete the task. The description further supplies Telegram contact links and numerous exchange signup links. This is therefore not neutral education about crypto risk: it is an operational pathway encouraging viewers to enter a reward-linked trading campaign. The educational framing and disclaimer cannot erase the repeated calls to participate.

citations.quote: Then click on Sell Tree and now your offer complete
The information provided in this video is for educational and informational purposes only

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference side emphasizes that the video explains eligibility and rewards, but those explanations are precisely what make the promotion actionable. The narration walks viewers through searching for TREE, buying, and selling, and the displayed controls invite joining. A disclaimer saying the material is educational does not change the practical instruction to complete the trading task or the presence of signup links.

citations.quote: After that just click on ELEDIBILITY
Then click on Sell Tree and now your offer complete

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The operational instructions are consistent with an instructional promotion, not proof of a scam. The material identifies the relevant pairs, states the minimum volume, and explains that rewards are distributed by rank and eligibility. The quoted buy-and-sell directions show how to participate, but they do not show a guaranteed profit, concealed fee, or false outcome. The disclaimer also warns that the information is not a substitute for professional advice.

citations.quote: The content presented on this channel should not be considered as a substitute for professional advice.
